evals.prompt: Turn our internal web dashboard at https://ops.example.com into a CLI. I only have the live app, not the source code. I need commands for projects list, project details, and deployments list.
evals.expected_output: The skill initializes a manifest, captures the live web app with agent-browser, infers a projects and deployments command tree, authors API and UI execution paths where possible, and renders a standalone CLI scaffold.
expectations: Creates captures, manifest, and cli workspace directories
Uses runtime observation rather than source code inspection
Creates commands with explicit path arrays
Uses auto mode only when both requestRecipeId and flowId are present
Runs the render-cli script to scaffold the generated project

evals.prompt: Build a CLI wrapper for the Slack desktop app. It is running locally with a remote debugging port on 9222. I want commands for unread channels and open channel by name.
evals.expected_output: The skill follows the Electron capture path, connects over CDP, captures the relevant views, writes a manifest with Electron metadata, and renders a CLI with unread and open-channel commands.
expectations: Uses Electron capture flow instead of web-only assumptions
Connects with agent-browser to a CDP port
Includes electron.cdpPort metadata in the manifest
Produces CLI commands backed by UI flows

evals.prompt: Generate a CLI for Superr Studio at http://localhost:3000. Start with workflows list, workflow get, workflow execute, artifacts list, and sandboxes list. Use API mode where stable and UI mode otherwise.
evals.expected_output: The skill captures the live app, derives the requested command set, records stable API recipes where available, preserves UI fallbacks, and generates a CLI scaffold without assuming source-code access.
expectations: Does not rely on repository source code to define commands
Creates both request recipes and UI flows when evidence supports them
Keeps command mode selection aligned with runtime-modes guidance
Includes auth and regeneration metadata in the manifest
Reports known gaps or risky selectors in the final summary
